MEMORANDUM

January 12, 1994

To: T. Baylies

From: M. Borsini

Re: HARLEY-DAVIDSON WEEKLY VOLUME REPORT - WEEK #13

This report details shipment data for Harley-Davidson Area 2 week ending 1/7/94 (week #13). This report contains a highlights section below and has three exhibits attached. The contents of the exhibits are as follows:

Exhibit I - Shipment and Order Tracking

Shipment and order tracking includes both shipments and orders broken out by allocation and back-up product thru week #11. Results are given on a weekly and year-to-date basis.
The Actual versus Budget section contains actual, budget and difference versus budget results by packing.

Exhibit II - Net Daily Shipment Tracking

Net daily shipments is a total of all Harley-Davidson product shipped. (Net daily shipments does not include orders.)
The exhibit contains actual, budget and difference versus budget results on a daily and year-to-date basis. At the bottom of the exhibit find daily average shipment numbers.

Exhibit III - Weekly Shipment Budget

The exhibits contains weekly budgets from 10/15/93 thru 12/30/94, as well as total 1993, total year I and total 1994 budgeted volumes.
